decisions.description: HashMap→BTreeMap for no_std compatibility
decisions.rationale: alloc::collections::HashMap not available in no_std; BTreeMap is available and avoids external hashbrown dependency

decisions.description: Eliminate all root-cause cascade errors before fixing deep type issues

decisions.description: Log macro/function ambiguity resolution: remove function imports, keep macros

decisions.description: Replace inline pub mod re-exports with proper module declarations
decisions.rationale: Circular re-exports caused infinite recursion in drivers/mod.rs

decisions.description: Created purge CLI tool for opencode session DB orphaned event cleanup
decisions.rationale: opencode-memfs event-sourcing creates 68K+ events per session lifecycle; none had owner_id set, causing unbounded DB growth (556 MB) and breaking 'opencode --continue'. Purge tool deletes orphaned events while preserving session messages/parts. Weekly cron keeps DB under control.

strategy_log.diagnosis: ~4700 compile errors; root causes masked by cascading failures from parse errors and duplicate names
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Root causes inflate error counts 2-5x; fixing them reveals true problem magnitude
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: E0252/E0255/E0659 and parse errors all eliminated; true error count ~3371 revealed
strategy_log.followup: 3371 deep type errors remain; need per-file human analysis for method names, trait bounds, types

strategy_log.diagnosis: E0659 ambiguous names (33 errors): log functions imported alongside macros
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Simplest change with least downstream impact; macros already in scope via #[macro_use]

strategy_log.diagnosis: E0252/E0255 duplicate names (30+ errors): same type imported and defined locally, or re-exported from two modules
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Identified root cause as redundant imports and conflicting module re-exports; removing duplicates preserves API
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: E0252/E0255 → 0; unblocked downstream modules
strategy_log.followup: Fixed in service_manager.rs, update/mod.rs, syscall/mod.rs, security/mod.rs, syscall/validator.rs, update/package_integration.rs

strategy_log.diagnosis: 'ambiguous +' parse errors (4 errors) and alloc::collections::HashSet not available in no_std
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Parenthesizing trait bounds in dyn types fixes ambiguity; BTreeSet replaces HashSet same as HashMap
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: ambiguous + → 0, HashSet → BTreeSet in 4 files

strategy_log.diagnosis: capability_sections count always 0 — line.startswith('##') catches '###' headings and exits in_caps before counter runs
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Minimal change — swap two if-statements so ### is checked before ##. This correctly counts sub-section headings under <capabilities>
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: architect.md: 0→3 counted; all agents will now report actual section counts

strategy_log.diagnosis: capability_sections count included ### headings outside </capabilities> tag
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Added </capabilities> detection to stop counting before <examples>, <skills>, etc. Now accurately reports 131 total sections across all agents
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: web-browser: 22→12 (removed examples), display-agent: 21→8. All agents now show accurate counts. Average: 5.7/agent

strategy_log.diagnosis: No golden datasets existed for agent behavior evaluation
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: DeepEval-inspired structured test cases with input/expected_output/metrics per agent. 46 test cases across all 23 agents covering 7 categories.
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: shared/golden/AGENTS.md + agent_tasks.json created with 46 test cases in 7 categories: tool_correctness, task_completion, refusal_handling, context_adherence, error_recovery, subagent_delegation, output_quality

strategy_log.diagnosis: eval CLI command referenced in shared/golden/AGENTS.md docs does not exist in __main__.py; --fail-under gate not implemented
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Docs already describe the command interface; implementing it completes the eval pipeline. --fail-under gate is the key pattern from Juanllenato eval-harness.

strategy_log.diagnosis: shared/eval/ only had AGENTS.md documentation; no YAML eval config driving actual evaluation
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: regokan/evalh pattern uses single YAML to drive all eval configuration; YAML is standard for this pattern

strategy_log.diagnosis: No persisted baseline existed for regression detection between eval runs
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Victor-David-Medina pattern uses baseline comparison for regression detection; enables --compare flag

strategy_log.diagnosis: No per-agent eval YAML configs existed for targeted agent evaluation
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: regokan/evalh pattern uses per-agent configs for targeted evaluation; easier to maintain than one monolith
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: 23 per-agent eval YAML files created with all test cases

strategy_log.diagnosis: CI pipeline existed only for build/release; no automated agent evaluation
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: linny006 cron pattern requires automated eval runs; weekly schedule + push triggers provide continuous monitoring
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: .github/workflows/agent-eval.yml created with schedule, push, PR triggers and summary output

strategy_log.diagnosis: Only behavioral test cases existed; no property-based invariants (e.g., all agents must have role section)
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: mpuodziukas-labs 3-layer eval includes property invariants; 7 tests added covering structural requirements
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: 7 property-based tests added; 53 total test cases; 3-layer eval pattern now operational

strategy_log.diagnosis: Root AGENTS.md had no documentation of the eval system or how agents are evaluated
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Documentation skeleton pattern requires system maps to be documented in root; enables discoverability
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: Eval System section added to root AGENTS.md with architecture, patterns, and key commands

strategy_log.diagnosis: Strategy library existed only in metacognitive-tracking skill docs; not available programmatically
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: HyperAgents pattern requires strategies to be enumerated in code; enables --list-strategies CLI command
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: STRATEGY_LIBRARY dict with 17 strategies added to __init__.py; list-strategies CLI command implemented

strategy_log.diagnosis: eval CLI command referenced in shared/golden/AGENTS.md docs does not exist in __main__.py
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Docs already describe the command interface; implementing it completes the eval pipeline
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: eval subcommand added to CLI with --agent, --config, --fail-under, --severity, --compare, --baseline flags

strategy_log.diagnosis: No way to run offline eval without agent runtime
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: MockProvider deterministically reads golden dataset and returns perfect scores — enables zero-cost CI eval
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: MockProvider class in __init__.py; --provider mock CLI flag; mock eval path in eval_agents()

strategy_log.diagnosis: Test cases have no version tracking — impossible to know if evaluation drift is from agent changes or test suite changes
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Embedding version in each test case's JSON schema ties version to data; baseline.json tracks which version was evaluated
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: version: '1.0' added to all 53 test cases; list_task_versions() function; --version CLI flag; version tracked in baseline.json

strategy_log.diagnosis: No way to quantify inter-rater agreement of golden test case categories
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Cohen's Kappa provides statistical measure of agreement; flags unreliable datasets with κ < 0.7
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: _cohens_kappa() and compute_cohens_kappa() in __init__.py; kappa subcommand; non-zero exit when κ < 0.7

strategy_log.diagnosis: No semantic quality scoring — only keyword matching and structural audits
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: LLM-as-judge measures faithfulness, task_completion, answer_relevancy; heuristic fallback when no endpoint configured
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: LLMJudge class with 3 metrics, heuristic fallback, batch evaluation; --judge-model CLI flag; agent_eval.yaml config

strategy_log.diagnosis: All eval runs sequential — slow for large agent count
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: AsyncExecutor uses asyncio.gather for concurrent eval; falls back to SyncExecutor on failure; minimal code change
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: SyncExecutor and AsyncExecutor classes; --executor sync|async CLI flag; integrated into eval_agents()

strategy_log.diagnosis: JSON-only output is hard to scan; no visual overview
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: ASCII bar charts with color thresholds provide instant readability; Victor-David-Medina weighted composite scorer pattern
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: render_scorecard() with ASCII bar charts, green/yellow/red thresholds; --scorecard CLI flag

strategy_log.diagnosis: No way to debug individual test case failures — must read full JSON output
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Dedicated inspect subcommand shows full test case details; regokan/evalh inspect pattern
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: inspect_case() function; inspect subcommand with --agent, --case, --failed flags

strategy_log.diagnosis: No way to see changes over time — each eval run is isolated
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Markdown comparison report with delta table against baseline; Victor-David-Medina regression pattern
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: generate_comparison_report() producing markdown with per-agent deltas; --compare flag; writes to reports/comparison_<date>.md

strategy_log.diagnosis: No side-by-side comparison of different agent configs against same test suite
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: A/B testing agent configs enables iterative improvement; victorwhale eval-harness-template pattern
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: ab_compare_agents() function; --ab CLI flag requiring --agent; per-case winner determination

strategy_log.diagnosis: Eval trends run on push/PR but results not persisted for trend analysis
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: linny006 cron+diff+commit pattern; schedule-only commit ensures clean history. Extends existing agent-eval.yml workflow
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: Save trend data step writes to reports/trends/; Commit trend data step commits only on schedule trigger; bot git config

strategy_log.diagnosis: opencode-memfs event-sourcing creates 68K+ orphaned events per session lifecycle; owner_id NULL for all 349 aggregates causing unbounded DB growth (556 MB) and breaking 'opencode --continue'
strategy_log.why_this_strategy: Events are intermediate streaming state, final session state is in message/part tables
strategy_log.outcome_evidence: DB: 556 MB -> 18 MB (95% reduction). Sessions list: timeout -> 3ms. opencode --continue restored.

meta_agent.summary: Implemented full agent evaluation system across 8 improvements
meta_agent.detail:
Phase 2 meta-agent session: Implemented evaluation system from 7 harness patterns.

Improvements:
1. eval CLI command with --fail-under gating (Juanllenato pattern)
2. YAML eval config shared/eval/agent_eval.yaml (regokan/evalh pattern)
3. 23 per-agent eval YAMLs (one per agent)
4. baseline.json for regression detection (Victor-David-Medina pattern)
5. Codified strategy library with 17 strategies (HyperAgents pattern)
6. GitHub Actions CI workflow for automated eval (linny006 pattern)
7. 7 property-based test cases added (mpuodziukas-labs pattern)
8. Eval system documented in root AGENTS.md

Current state: 53 test cases, 98.1% pass rate, 15 strategy applications, 14 strategies tracked

meta_agent.summary: Implemented remaining 10 eval system improvements in parallel
meta_agent.detail:
All 10 improvements from the harness analysis are now implemented:

1. MockProvider (#2) — deterministic offline eval via --provider mock
2. Task Versioning (#10) — version: '1.0' on all 53 test cases, --version CLI
3. Cohen's Kappa (#6) — kappa subcommand, flags κ < 0.7 datasets
4. LLM-as-Judge (#1) — LLMJudge class with 3 metrics, heuristic fallback
5. Multi-Executor (#9) — SyncExecutor/AsyncExecutor, --executor sync|async
6. Tiered Scorecard (#7) — ASCII bar charts with color thresholds, --scorecard
7. Per-Case Inspect (#8) — inspect subcommand with --case and --failed
8. Comparison Report (#3) — markdown diff against baseline, --compare
9. A/B Config Comparison (#5) — --ab flag for side-by-side config comparison
10. Auto-Commit Trends (#4) — CI commit of trend data on weekly schedule

All 10 were written directly from the plan without needing meta-agent dispatch.
